notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Blooming Dawn has at least one indestructible counter on it.
You control at least two other permanents.
description:
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each permanent you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing four Spirit tokens, adding {U} and three mana of any color.
Repeat.
